I told Pree, in a thread on their message in #central-team, that the agreed figure is **87 seats** for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal.

- **Where it comes from:** On Oct 14 Hollis posted 268 in #central-team, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because they'd read the wrong line. I re-read the channel and nothing has changed it since. Pree is a member of #central-team, so they can see both of Hollis's posts.
- **A problem with the brain:** The fact I saved on Oct 14 (87 seats, replacing 268) didn't come back when I looked it up today; the lookup returned nothing. So I answered from the channel history instead. That fact may not be saved, so for now the channel history is the reliable record.
- **Sharing:** A seat count is an operational fact, and Pree is on the Central team, so no approval was needed.
